# rbclabs

> Personal portfolio and project showcase for Berk Çiçek — DevOps engineer, platform builder and Web3 developer based in Turkey.

rbclabs is a static, multilingual (Turkish / English / German) personal website that documents Berk Çiçek's professional work, open-source projects, hackathon achievements and technical writing. The site has no backend; all content is rendered as plain HTML with Tailwind CSS for styling and vanilla JavaScript for interactivity and i18n.

## Pages

- [Home](https://berkcicekk.github.io/index.html): Hero section with role overview (DevOps Engineer), key stats (10+ hackathons, 6 top rankings), a "currently building" card for the CENK Project (5G security research), and a link to the writing library.
- [Projects](https://berkcicekk.github.io/projects.html): Selected work including Joins (Turkish live quiz platform), zk-File Transfer (award-winning zero-knowledge file transfer on Solana), BLAZR (Algorand micro-investment app, ALGOHACK 2nd place), Launchpad Project (MINA smart contracts, zk-Ignite Cohort 3 grant) and a Startup Weekend mobile app concept.
- [Experience](https://berkcicekk.github.io/experience.html): Chronological work history — Cyrops (Cyber Security Specialist, 2025–present), Cuberium / Siber Vatan (Team Lead & Web3 Developer, 2022–2024), Turkcell Technology (Software Developer Intern, Jul–Sep 2024), Serim Software (Backend Developer Intern, Aug–Sep 2023). Education: Computer Engineering, Bülent Ecevit University (2021–2026). Awards: HackSolana #1/20 (SuperteamTR, Nov 2024), SuperteamTR Local Grant (Dec 2024), BLAZR #2 ALGOHACK (Rise In, Istanbul), MINA zk-Ignite Cohort 3 Grant (Mar 2024), Startup Weekend #3 Zonguldak (Mar 2023), Ödeal GPT AI Hackathon Finalist (Nov 2023).
- [Writing](https://berkcicekk.github.io/writing.html): Technical articles published on Medium (@cckberk) covering blockchain security (Blockchain Hack Vaka Analizi), zero-knowledge proofs, Solidity smart contract development (5-part series), and blockchain ecosystems (Togg Mobility, Developer Toolbox, Para Nedir?).
